briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This scan has uncovered several key developments related to fraud and investigations in Minnesota. These incidents highlight the need for continued vigilance and oversight of programs meant to provide aid to vulnerable populations. The entities and individuals involved in these schemes must be held accountable. Next steps include continuing to track the investigations and identifying any patterns or connections between entities and programs.
